title: The ones in between drown
odia:
ଦୃଢ଼େ ତରନ୍ତି
ମୂଢେ ତରନ୍ତି
ମଝି ମଝିଆ ବୁଡି ମରନ୍ତି।
literal_meaning: The steadfast cross over; the foolish cross over; those in between drown and die.
meaning_odia: ଦୃଢ଼ ଲୋକ ଓ ମୂଢ଼ ଲୋକ—ଦୁହେଁ ତରିଯାଆନ୍ତି, ଅଥଚ ମଝି ଅବସ୍ଥାରେ ଥିବା ଲୋକ ବୁଡ଼ିଯାଆନ୍ତି ବୋଲି ଧାଡ଼ିଗୁଡ଼ିକ କହୁଛି। ଆମ ସମ୍ପାଦକୀୟ ପାଠରେ ଏହା ଅଧା ବୁଝାମଣା ଓ ଅନିଶ୍ଚିତ ସ୍ଥିତିକୁ ଟିପ୍ପଣୀ କରେ। ମୂଢ଼ତାରେ ସଫଳତା ମିଳେ ବୋଲି କହିବା ଏହି ଢଗର ବିରୋଧାଭାସ; ଏହା ଅଜ୍ଞତାକୁ ଉପଦେଶ କିମ୍ବା ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ କରିବାକୁ ବାରଣ ନୁହେଁ।
explanation: Two unlike groups reach the other side, while the people between them drown. Our editorial reading hears a pointed contrast between a settled position and an insecure halfway understanding. The surprising success assigned to the foolish gives the saying its paradox; it need not be taken as advice to remain ignorant.
usage_example: Original imagined example: Someone adopts half of a method, questions the rest without understanding it, and cannot make it work. An observer recalls the people in between who fail to cross.
cultural_context: The repeated ତରନ୍ତି sets up two safe crossings before the last line overturns that rhythm with drowning. A three-part contrast, rather than a simple praise of wisdom, makes the saying memorable.

odia_summary: ଦୁଇ ପ୍ରାନ୍ତ ତରିଯାଏ, ମଝି ଅବସ୍ଥା ବୁଡ଼ିଯାଏ—ଅଧା ବୁଝାମଣାକୁ ନେଇ ବିରୋଧାଭାସପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଟିପ୍ପଣୀ।
